title: Candlelit Summoning
description: A woman in a blue dress kneels on a decaying ornate room floor, holding a glowing candle while a spectral female figure emerges from a swirling portal of blue and purple smoke in a torn wall. A disembodied hand extends a lit candle from the left foreground amid scattered ropes, white lilies, and broken picture frames.
prompt: A woman in a flowing blue Victorian dress kneels on the floor of a decaying red wallpapered room with torn baroque frames and peeling paint, holding a single lit candle that illuminates her face. A ghostly translucent female spirit with flowing hair emerges from a swirling vortex of blue and purple smoke tearing through the wall. A pale disembodied hand extends another lit candle from the left foreground. Scattered black ropes, white lilies, and broken furniture lie on the floor. Dramatic cinematic lighting, moody atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting.
